s34-bwe-nzuukuka.text: When I wake up, I drink tea.
alts: When I wake up I drink tea.
Whenever I wake up, I drink tea.

s34-bwe-ntuuka.text: When I arrive, I will call you.
alts: When I arrive I will call you.
When I get there, I’ll call you.

s34-enkuba-bwetonnya.text: When it rains, I don’t go.
alts: If it rains, I don’t go.
When it rains I do not go.

s34-singa-nnina-ssente.text: If I had money, I would buy a car.
alts: If I had money I would buy a car.
If I had money, I’d buy a car.

s34-singa-tewali-nkuba.text: If there were no rain, I would go.
alts: If it weren’t raining, I would go.
If there was no rain, I would have gone.
I would like some tea, please.

s34-nnandyagadde-okugenda.text: I would like to go to {@getaway}.
alts: I would love to go to {@getaway}.
When you get there, call me.

s-mvua-ikinyesha.text: If it rains, we will stay at home.
alts: When it rains, we’ll stay home.

s-nikipata-pesa.text: If I get money, I will travel.
alts: When I get money, I’ll travel.

s-ningekuwa-tajiri.text: If I were rich, I would buy a car.
alts: If I was rich, I’d buy a car.

s-ningenunua.text: I would buy a big house.

s-ikiwa.text: If you have a question, ask.
alts: If you’ve got a question, ask.

phrases: When I wake up, I drink tea.
When it rains, I don’t go.
If I had money, I would buy a car.

u34s2l3.line: If you had a lot of money, what would you buy?
options: I would buy a big house.
When I wake up, I drink tea.

u34s3l3.line: Are you coming to the ceremony tomorrow?
